description.value: Western Financial Place (locally known as Rex Plex) is Cranbrook's primary arena and multi-use recreation complex, home to the Junior A Cranbrook Bucks hockey team and a wide range of live events. The facility includes The Studio fitness centre offering spin, yoga, and barre classes, a full-service restaurant, and concession stands. With 953 parking stalls, full elevator and accessibility features, and bus service on four routes, it functions as the entertainment and recreation hub for the East Kootenay region.
